pages_text: Overview: Knowledge Transfer for Project Polaris. Project Polaris is a scalable cloud infrastructure deployment designed to streamline data processing pipelines. Led by Senior Architect Sarah Connor, this project enables real-time data synchronization across multi-region clusters.
